text: While known in the downtown core as a major travel route, Richmond Street West starts at Niagara Street as a residential road, primarily consisting of single family homes and row-houses. Residents have reached out to my office with concerns about road safety and speeding along the street, between Niagara Street and Tecumseth Street. My office polled local residents and the majority were in favour. In order to make the community safer for all, I recommend installing speed humps on this portion of the street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Richmond Street West, between Niagara Street and Tecumseth Street. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install four speed humps on Richmond Street West, between Niagara Street and Tecumseth Street, generally as shown on Attachment 1 to the letter (November 10, 2023) from Deputy Mayor Ausma Malik.
